method: Read-only inspection of all 13 original native PNGs, independent exact RGB and original ARGB counts, receipt/protocol readback, and frozen fixture source review. No edited or synthesized images; no native launch or product edits.

historical_gc.visual: Committed image contains the retained upper boundary label; reset image restores two older labels at the same chart location. Native resource checks independently retain 500-label removal, oldest retained, provisional rollback, committed deletion, creation-order and reset predicates.
historical_gc.view_scope: Native scale 0, END 0, one pixel per bar; actual first 1056. This proves the same historical GC boundary without a nonzero relative viewport offset. Prior platform screenshot resets at first 662 remain preserved failures and are not claimed repaired.

idle_foreground.buffer_scope: Current values of buffers 0 through 7 exact equality; score buffer 8 is outside this particular idle assertion.
idle_foreground.nonvacuity: Baseline source predicate requires active=1 and buy_allowed=1, nonzero-alpha foreground pixels, stable dimensions and three successive equal resource observations before expiry.
idle_foreground.chart_event_scope: Frozen source phases 14 and 15 issue grid toggle/restore plus ChartRedraw, then phase 16 waits past expiry. No callback counter or direct proof of each OnTimer callback is claimed.
idle_foreground.priming_png_scope: The two normal_timer_layout PNGs are pre-baseline paint/geometry diagnostics. Actual idle acceptance uses the later original nonempty ARGB foreground snapshots, not these priming PNGs.

visual_observations: Actual dark and light attachment PNGs show recognizable table text and zone label, with complete right table border inside the price axis.
Basic native magenta horizontal reference intersects lime canvas stroke; off-midpoint cyan reference intersects red stroke; native yellow time marker equals lime right endpoint.

Theme and zoom image retains price alignment and translucent green shading. Overlap image retains an opaque level under the translucent status table; native resource checks verify source-over color behavior.
Retention and renderer reinit PNG files have identical SHA256; the native 500-line and ownership assertions pass.
All 13 PNGs were visually inspected at their original copied dimensions; no outstanding clipping or vertical placement defect was found within these samples.

cleanup.native_evidence: Gold handle/symbol cleanup, indicator detach cleanup, renderer object ownership/collision cleanup, both owned charts absent and both remaining synthetic symbols deleted all PASS.

limitations: Visual samples use synthetic native charts; this is not a TradingView versus MT5 whole-chart pixel identity proof. Font and label geometry remain native approximations.
Actual-Pine numeric parity is a separate finite frozen OANDA Gold M1/default-input proof in the same run; it does not establish broker-feed equality or all parameter/calendar combinations.
Controlled renderer cases execute the frozen renderer include inside the fixture; actual attachments, template reload and idle tests exercise the staged production indicator EX5.
Idle stability proves unchanged output through the observed no-quote interval and issued chart-setting commands, not an instrumented count of OnTimer callbacks.
No OS network/shared-updater containment is claimed. The native receipt records updater and MCP activity and marks platform review required; packaging must retain that disclosure.
No production installation or trade action occurred in this review.
